facts.fact: Lucy 已经一周没见到 Saskia，快把自己熬疯了；她纠结一小时，把邀请写在笔记本纸上、折成中学时那种小纸包，从 Saskia 门缝下塞进去，好让两个人都能装作没这回事。
facts.anchor: Lucy argues with herself for an hour before writing a message on a piece of notebook paper, folding it into a little packet like they did in middle school

facts.fact: 她意识到 Saskia 听得见她的一举一动，于是穿上最软的袜子、悄悄走到沙发边，把那双出卖她的脚收到身下藏起来。
facts.anchor: She puts on her softest socks and tiptoes silently to the couch, drawing her betraying feet up underneath her, hiding them.

facts.fact: 六点零三分，她刚下楼确认有没有新纸条、又沮丧地拖着身体爬回螺旋楼梯时，门上响起了敲击声。
facts.anchor: while she is dejectedly dragging herself back up the spiral staircase, there is a knock on her door

facts.fact: 门口站着 Saskia，捧着一束花，不是超市买的那种；花来自她自己的园子，四周环着龟背竹叶。
facts.anchor: Saskia is there holding a bouquet of flowers, but not grocery store flowers.

facts.fact: Saskia 把装着绿植的大玻璃罐递给她，说自己不会烘焙；她戴着一只黑色口罩，这让 Lucy 觉得奇怪。
facts.anchor: “I can’t bake,” Saskia says, handing her the large mason jar that holds the greenery.

facts.fact: Saskia 接过冰水，短暂掀起口罩喝了一口；Lucy 看着她的喉颈和微张的嘴唇，看得发怔。
facts.anchor: Saskia reaches for it, briefly holds up her mask to drink.

facts.fact: Lucy 让 Saskia 选一部自己最爱的恐怖片，Saskia 毫不犹豫地选了《Jennifer’s Body》，还问她以前看过没有。
Lucy 闻到暖香草味，知道 Saskia 用了她的护手霜；她开始想象对方稍后独自在卧室里的样子。
facts.anchor: Lucy smells the warm vanilla and knows Saskia has used some of her hand lotion.
